results.title: Amongst the 8 tech companies that announced job cuts recently, only one is led by a woman. I find it interesting that it's also the one that offered the most generous (publicly disclosed) severance… | Charles Tenot
results.content: Amongst the 8 tech companies that announced job cuts recently, only one is led by a woman. I find it interesting that it's also the one that offered the most generous (publicly disclosed) severance package. Microsoft, Pipedrive, Squarespace, Angi, NICE, Block, Amazon and Canva all announced job cuts, restructurings or buyouts lately. Canva, led by Melanie Perkins, stood out They announced a restructuring affecting 1,271 employees, or 22% of their workforce. Here's what they offered employees [...] offered employees leaving: → 6 months or more of salary, including statutory severance, in every country → 12 months of healthcare coverage where provided → removal of the 1-year equity vesting cliff for recent hires → employees get to keep their MacBooks → career coaching, interview preparation and 1 year of LinkedIn Premium → the option to apply for a $10K grant to start a business, with no equity taken For context, the average tech severance package in 2024 was roughly 11 weeks. This package [...] weeks. This package goes way beyond what's usually done and my reading is that they really aimed at helping people with all the little details. I don't know if it's a coincidence that the only female CEO in this group offered such a generous package, but I find it interesting. I wrote last week about how layoffs are often the consequence of poor management decisions. And while I still believe many layoffs could be avoided, sometimes they're necessary. results.content: Airbyte also expanded its certified connector portfolio with Ashby, Gmail, MySQL, Pipedrive and Reddit Ads. Airbyte engineers maintain these connectors, back them with support service-level agreements and follow a published policy for breaking changes. The additions strengthen pipelines for operational and text-rich business data, including email conversations, recruiting feedback and sales notes.
